elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no professional-and-workmanlike performance warranty; it only addresses conformity with Documentation and defective media.

elements.element: Software conforms to the applicable Documentation.
elements.evidence: The clause only warrants that Software will perform in “substantial accordance” with the Documentation, which is narrower than unqualified conformity.

elements.element: Service deliverables conform to the applicable Documentation.
elements.evidence: The clause addresses the MarketSite.net Service but does not warrant that all service deliverables conform to applicable Documentation; it also uses the narrower “substantial accordance” standard.

elements.element: The software documentation-conformance warranty lasts at least twelve (12) months.
elements.evidence: The Warranty Period is twelve months from Corio’s acceptance of the Software.

elements.element: The service or service-deliverable warranty lasts at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: Although the MarketSite.net Service is nominally included in a twelve-month Warranty Period, that period runs from acceptance of the Software rather than from performance or acceptance of each service or service deliverable, so ninety days of coverage is not assured for each service.

elements.element: Repair is available as a warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: Commerce One is required only to use “commercially reasonable efforts to correct,” not actually to repair or correct the nonconformity.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must replace the Software and MarketSite.net Service free of charge if correction is reasonably not possible, and must replace defective media returned during the Warranty Period.

elements.element: A refund is available as a warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: If a breach cannot reasonably be corrected at Commerce One’s expense, Corio may terminate and receive a refund of all prepaid fees.

elements.element: The Software, deliverables, and Services comply with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: The Software and Services contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The warranty is limited to malicious code that was “willfully introduced” and is designed to disable, erase, or alter specified items; it does not provide an unqualified no-malicious-code warranty.

elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: No professional-and-workmanlike services warranty is included.

elements.element: Software conforms to the applicable Documentation.
elements.evidence: The operative standard is only performance in “substantial accordance” with the Documentation.

elements.element: Service deliverables conform to the applicable Documentation.
elements.evidence: The clause does not cover all service deliverables and only provides a substantial-accordance warranty for the identified MarketSite.net Service.

elements.element: The software documentation-conformance warranty lasts at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The rendered twelve-month period from Software acceptance exceeds ninety days.

elements.element: The service or service-deliverable warranty lasts at least thirty (30) days.
elements.evidence: The MarketSite.net Service period is measured from Software acceptance, not from performance or acceptance of each service or service deliverable, so thirty days of coverage for each service is not assured.

elements.element: Repair is available as a warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: A duty to use commercially reasonable correction efforts is weaker than an obligation to repair or correct.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: Replacement is expressly required when correction is reasonably not possible, and defective media must also be replaced.

elements.element: A refund is available as a warranty remedy.
elements.evidence: Corio may terminate and recover all prepaid fees when the warranty breach cannot reasonably be corrected.

result.reason: The operative redline successfully creates a twelve-month software warranty measured from acceptance and removes the fixed cutoff, but the margin comment cannot cure the missing professional-and-workmanlike and legal-compliance warranties, the qualified malicious-code warranty, the limited substantial-conformance standard, or the lack of an actual repair obligation. The service period is also tied to Software acceptance rather than each service or deliverable. Because neither complete position is reached—and the twelve-month period unnecessarily applies to the MarketSite.net Service—the redline is not minimal. It otherwise leaves unrelated commercial provisions in place and introduces no direct contradiction.
